prototypeScope: V1.35 delta package: one Orange plate with the A7Z saddle V2 body, lid and tray (D-028). The V1.29 saddle body and lid of the V1.33 White plate are superseded; orange is the interim colour until white PETG is restocked.
knownFitBoundary: Board + Radxa 6530B screwed from below with four M2 x 6 through the tray bosses and the board holes into the heatsink's threaded bosses; the tray drops in after the two roof screws S-shell_pack-01/02 (M2 x 10, heads 0.65 mm under the tray); lid clamps the heatsink with two M2 x 6 side screws. 6530B base height (3.1) and fin-block start (d 6.4) are photo estimates, measured on the part before fitting. Printed sizes not measured.
processOverrideReason: The V1.17 White support-interface overrides (3 interface layers at 0.15 spacing, 0.2 top z, interface 40 mm/s, bridge 30 mm/s, support ironing, 0.2 first layer) applied to the Orange plate: the saddle body stands on tree support over its whole underside, as the printed V1.29 body did on White.
